podcast.body: A song from Fairground Attraction's 1988 album "The First of a Million Kisses." It became a number one hit in the UK and won several awards there. In North America, it was an "out-of-left field thing" for Alt Rock Radio and was the only significant song the band managed to achieve in the region. As of February 2026, it had 55.2 million Spotify plays and 10 million YouTube views, with a One Hit Wonder Power Rating of 4.50 out of 10. "While this song hit number one in the UK and won a bunch of awards, North America had it as a out-of-left field thing for all Rock Radio."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
